default: Reference only (not produced by the optimiser): uniform t = 4 mm, 186.8 g, 30.85 W, imbalance 3.69 % (92 % of the 4 % limit), 19.25 mm, 34.7° span. In-plane gap (4.05 vs 4.00 mm), web, outer radius (77.98 vs 78.00) and J (12) are all at their limits. Every goal winner below beats it on its own goal.
g_bal: Best combined score (2.3500), only 0.07 % ahead of Terminals closest (2.3516). t = 3.75 mm with 7 widened segments. Against the default: +27 g (214 g), but −2.6 W loss (28.25 W), −0.91 points imbalance (2.78 %), −0.25 mm height (19.0 mm) and a 30.5° span. Binding: web = t, in-plane gap, lug pitch (15.2 vs 15 mm), J 12 at the terminals. Terminals closest has the same span with lower loss and imbalance but needs 17 g more copper at t = 4.
g_loss: Lowest loss (score 3.1359): 26.78 W, 4.08 W (13 %) below the default, bought with +51.5 g copper (238.4 g) in 8 widened segments at t = 4: more copper on the busy ring sections lowers their resistance. Runner-up Lowest imbalance is 0.31 W worse with 8.7 g less copper. The 35° terminal span binds: allowing 60° or 90° lowers the loss further. Also at limit: web, gap, outer radius, lug pitch.
g_height: Lowest height (score 2.7372): 18.25 mm, 1.0 mm below the default, at t = 3 mm with 7 widened segments. It also beats the default on loss (29.84 W) and imbalance (3.03 %) for +3.9 g copper (190.7 g). The least-copper design is physically 0.25 mm lower (18.0 mm at t = 2.75) but scores worse on this goal because of its 35.2 W loss and 3.81 % imbalance. Binding: web = t, gap, outer radius, lug pitch.
g_mass: Least copper (score 2.2741): 146.8 g, 40 g (21 %) below the default, at t = 2.75 mm with every section cut to the J limit (9 parts within 3 % of 12 A/mm²) and 3 segments widened back to meet the 4 % imbalance limit; 18.0 mm tall. Costs: 35.2 W (+4.4 W) and 3.81 % imbalance (95 % of the limit). Binding: outer and inner radius exactly at their limits, gap, span. Runner-up (Lowest height) carries 44 g more copper.
g_imb: Lowest imbalance with copper only (score 3.1426): 2.514 %, 1.18 points below the default, with +42.8 g copper (229.6 g) and −3.77 W (27.09 W), t = 4, 7 widened segments on the weaker paths. Lowest loss is within 0.001 points on raw imbalance but carries 8.7 g more copper. The 35° terminal span binds: 60° and 90° spans reach about 2.0 % and 1.5 %. Also at limit: web, gap, outer radius, lug pitch.
g_close: Smallest terminal span (score 4.2107): 30.5° (gaps 15° + 15.5°, held by the 15 mm lug pitch), 4.2° tighter than the default. The balanced design reaches the same 30.5° but scores worse because of 1.09 W more loss and 0.18 points more imbalance. Itself t = 4, 7 widened segments: 230.9 g, 27.16 W, 2.60 %, 19.25 mm.
v_span60: Allowing a 60° terminal span (fully used) gives 2.021 % imbalance (score 2.6541 vs 3.1426 for the 35° optimum): 0.49 points lower, for +19.7 g copper (249.3 g) and −1.5 W loss (25.57 W), height unchanged at 19.25 mm. The terminals spread so the path that was far from its terminal gets closer, and 9 ring segments are widened. Binding: span 60°, web = t, in-plane gap, outer radius, J 12 at the terminals. This design was confirmed against the best of three independent runs.
v_span90: A 90° span (fully used) lets the optimiser change the ring arrangement (L2 inside, L3 outside, L1 swaps) and go to t = 4.5 mm with widened segments: 1.529 % imbalance (score 2.2326), 0.49 points below the 60° case, and the lowest loss of all (23.56 W). Costs: 277.0 g copper (+48 % vs the default) and the tallest stack (23.75 mm, because the thicker plane sits higher). Binding: span 90°, web = t, in-plane gap, outer radius. Confirmed as the best of three independent runs.
v_j15: Least copper with J ≤ 15 (score 2.2327), better than the 12 A/mm² least-copper design (2.2741), which also meets these rules. 140.8 g, 6 g (4 %) lighter at the same t = 2.75 mm and 18.0 mm. Peak busbar J is only 12.43 (spoke F9): the 15 A/mm² allowance is not what limits it; the 4 % imbalance (3.96 %), the radial limits and the gap are. Cost: 36.3 W (+1.1 W).
v_pi6: Least copper with 6 % imbalance allowed (score 1.9971): 119.1 g, 27.7 g below the 4 % least-copper design and 36 % below the default, at t = 2.75 and 18.0 mm, every section at the J limit (11 parts within 3 % of 12 A/mm²) and nothing widened. Imbalance ends at 5.21 %, so J, the outer radius, span and gap are what limit it. Cost: 39.24 W (+8.4 W vs the default).
v_bal: With path balancing allowed, imbalance is essentially zero (0.0001 %, score 0.6655). Balancing resistances 314, 276 and 274 µΩ (largest 63 % of the 500 µΩ bound) at three welds; the other three paths need none. t = 3 mm with 7 widened segments: 191.6 g, 18.25 mm, 30.5° span. Cost: 39.53 W busbar + joint loss including 9.34 W in the balancing resistances, 12.4 W above the copper-only lowest-imbalance design, plus three extra wire lengths to build.
